final: WITH c AS (SELECT m.member_id AS member_id, m.position AS position, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position), s AS (SELECT member_id, position, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), r AS (SELECT member_id, position, cnt, share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS rk FROM s) SELECT member_id, position, cnt AS attendance_count, share FROM r WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC
